title: Bound on a multiplication column
statement: Let $a$ and $b$ be finite bit strings, and let $j$ be a nonnegative integer. Define the column sum as the sum over positions $p$ in $a$ of the product of the bit of $a$ at $p$ and the bit of $b$ at position $j-p$, taking a missing bit to be $0$ and including a term only when $p\le j$. This sum is at most the length of $a$.
